kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتهادر (form VI)
# نَتَهَادَرُ (natahādaru) /na.ta.haː.da.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَهَادَرَ (tahādara)
# نَتَهَادَرَ (natahādara) /na.ta.haː.da.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَهَادَرَ (tahādara)
# نَتَهَادَرْ (natahādar) /na.ta.haː.dar/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَهَادَرَ (tahādara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
